title: MOMENT Lab
text:
Information We Collect
You can browse the MOMENT website without providing personal information.
If you choose to contact us, sign up for an activity, complete a study screener, or follow a link to participate in one of our studies, you may be asked to provide information such as your name, email address, phone number, or other information needed for that specific activity.
We only ask for information that is necessary for the purpose described to you.

title: MOMENT Lab
text:
Research Studies
The MOMENT website provides information about our research studies and may include links to study screening or enrollment pages.
Research studies have their own eligibility requirements, consent processes, and privacy protections. Before participating in a study, you will receive information explaining what information will be collected, how it will be used, and how your privacy will be protected.
Visiting this website or contacting MOMENT does not mean that you are enrolled in a research study.

title: MOMENT Lab
text:
How We Use Information
Information you voluntarily provide through the website may be used to:

Respond to your questions or requests
Provide information about MOMENT programs, studies, or activities
Determine potential eligibility for a research study when you choose to complete a study screener
Communicate with you about opportunities you have expressed interest in

Information collected as part of a research study will be handled according to that study’s approved research procedures and consent materials.

title: MOMENT Lab
text:
Website Data
Like many websites, limited technical information may be collected automatically when you visit, such as your browser type, device type, pages visited, and general website usage information.
This information may be used to understand how people use the website and to improve its content and accessibility.

title: MOMENT Lab
text:
External Links
Our website may contain links to other websites or services, including LSU Health Sciences Center resources, healthcare organizations, community partners, and research platforms.
When you leave the MOMENT website, the privacy practices of the website or service you visit will apply. MOMENT is not responsible for the privacy practices or content of external websites.

title: MOMENT Lab
text:
Protecting Your Information
We take reasonable steps to protect information shared with us. Research information is managed according to applicable LSU Health Sciences Center New Orleans policies, approved research protocols, and relevant privacy and research requirements.
However, no website or electronic communication system can guarantee complete security.

title: MOMENT Lab
text:
Children’s Privacy
The MOMENT website is not designed to knowingly collect personal information from children through the public website unless specifically described as part of an approved research or community activity.

title: MOMENT Lab
text:
Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy as the MOMENT website, our programs, or our practices change. The date at the top of this page indicates when the policy was most recently updated.

title: MOMENT Lab
text:
